title: Examining Physician Counseling to Promote Adoption of Physical Activity: A Controlled Trial
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to systematically test the efficacy of two physician-based interventions in changing physical activity patterns of adults over a 20-month period.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ambulatory adults

Exclusion Criteria:

* cardiovascular disease
* respiratory disease
condition: No Specific Conditions Are Being Examined
